profile.dividendPolicy: The Company will consider paying dividends based on the profitability each year and overall performance under legal requirements and will refrain from paying dividends in case of accumulated losses. The Company has a policy to pay dividends to shareholders of not less than 50% of the net profit according to the separate financial statements, after deducting corporate income tax, legal reserves, and other reserves (if any), taking into account the financial position, cash flow, liquidity, investment plans, and other factors as deemed appropriate by the board of directors. The dividend payment must not significantly affect the Company's normal operations. The board of directors resolves to pay dividends and proposes for approval from the shareholders' meeting, except for interim dividends, which the board of directors has the authority to approve and report to the shareholders' meeting at the next meeting. The dividend payment must not exceed the accumulated profit of the Company's separate financial statements and must comply with relevant laws.
